description: This file appears to be a C source file implementing functions related to pack file geometries in a version control system (likely Git). It defines functions for initializing, splitting, selecting preferred packs, removing redundant packs, and releasing resources associated with pack geometries.

methods.name: uint32_t pack_geometry_weight(struct packed_git * p)
methods.description: Calculates the weight (size) of a pack by opening its index and returning the number of objects.

methods.name: int pack_geometry_cmp(const void * va,const void * vb)
methods.description: Comparison function for sorting packs based on their weight.

methods.name: void pack_geometry_init(struct pack_geometry * geometry,struct existing_packs * existing,const struct pack_objects_args * args)
methods.description: Initializes the pack geometry by collecting relevant pack files based on criteria such as locality and keep flags, then sorts them.

methods.name: void pack_geometry_split(struct pack_geometry * geometry)
methods.description: Splits the collection of packs into groups based on geometric progression of their sizes to optimize pack management.

methods.name: struct:packed_git * pack_geometry_preferred_pack(struct pack_geometry * geometry)
methods.description: Selects the preferred pack among the geometry, typically the largest pack above the split line that is local.

methods.name: void pack_geometry_remove_redundant(struct pack_geometry * geometry,struct string_list * names,struct existing_packs * existing,const char * packdir)
methods.description: Removes redundant packs from the collection that are not needed, based on a list of names and existing pack info.

methods.name: void pack_geometry_release(struct pack_geometry * geometry)
methods.description: Releases resources associated with the pack geometry.
